claim: Creating a fresh worktree captures the binding a newer worktree took, so create one before retrying the refused operation.
because: Measured: zero observed successes. At the moment of refusal the agent's own worktree was the newest on the machine, with the next not created for another two minutes, so there was nothing newer to have taken the binding. The condition the technique was supposed to create arrived later on its own, which read as confirmation.
